name: KAREN

description.short: Modern corset A-line gown with beaded lace, sequins, and detachable train.
description.full:
Pricing & Availability

  • Made to Order: ₱25,000
  • Custom size available

Details

  • Style: Modern Corset A-Line with Detachable Train
  • Fabric: Premium Beaded Lace & Glistening Sequins
  • Color: White
  • Design: High-glamour structure with a versatile silhouette

Features

  • Structured Corset Bodice: Features prominent exposed boning and a sweetheart neckline for a dramatic, snatched fit.
  • Glistening Lace Detail: Adorned with intricate floral lace and shimmering sequins for a radiant, high-fashion look.
  • Elegant Long Sleeves: Fitted off-the-shoulder lace sleeves that add a touch of sophisticated romance.
  • A-Line Silhouette: A graceful, flared skirt that offers a classic and flattering shape.
  • Detachable Train: Comes with a matching voluminous lace train that can be removed for more ease of movement.
  • Adjustable Back: Ensures a precise and comfortable fit to enhance the sculpted bodice.

Add-on

  • Matching Veil: Available as an add-on; price varies depending on length and design.
